comment: Read from src/Mavka.cpp at commit e511dd9, version 2.0.1; the code has not changed since the 2.0.1 bump at ed9c274. The pitch knob's own range is 0 to 1, so the knob alone covers a single octave upwards from C4 and every lower pitch has to come from the v/oct jack, which the maker's README does not mention. The level CV jacks are summed with the knob in the knob's own 0 to 1 units, at src/Mavka.cpp:75, 79, 83 and 87, so they behave as a 0 to 1V control rather than the 0 to 10V a reader would expect; the README says only that the CV value will be added to the knob value. The phase counter wraps at 0.5 and subtracts 1, so it runs from -0.5 to 0.5, and the saw, triangle and square are all built from that signed phase.
